title: Inside Halberd Mills
text: The cooperative began trading in 1999, in a converted grain store in Cawden Vale that it still occupies. Everything it sells is a wool blanket of one kind or another, and the range has barely changed. The Fenmoor design award, won in 2015, hangs framed in the entrance. Asked about the size of the place this year, members put it at a couple of hundred of us, give or take.
notes: Set B. Magazine profile; reports scale as reported speech rather than a figure. Dated within months of set-b-01 and set-b-02 so the membership figures cannot be read as successive snapshots.
